sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Corpeso is a fire-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (D), Agility (C).

sections.title: Is the Corpeso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (D), Agility (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
